A Note on Disjoint Decompositions of [0,1) into Closed Sets

A proof that a half-open interval cannot be partitioned into countably many sets closed in the real line.

The distinction between being closed in the real line and relatively closed in an interval matters here. The note develops the obstruction using point-set topology and Baire category.

Background

Closed sets and the Baire category theorem.
